title: A WordPress sync whose id map grew over many syncs neither crashes the database server nor stops: links in text are renumbered in bounded statements; references outside the adapter are counted in grouped calls; a stopped merge says why
expect: S1: five chained WordPress syncs (both sides creating posts, occupied numbers, a three-deep chain, a media upload, nothing new, edits at each depth) all apply with every live post at its copy number; nest depth stays ≤ TEXT_NEST; grouped reference counts equal the one-per-number answer; a refused statement's detail names the error without row values

selectors.host: live_sync.py IdMap.renumber TEXT_NEST, IdMap.unhandled_refs ref_columns REF_CHUNK, SqlError, main MERGE_FAILED detail; webroot-sync.sh engine_said

fence: No sync statement grows with the history of the site past what the database server can evaluate
